observations: All 28 bechina edges for Torah 15 are fully accounted for within 7 packages (6 good + 1 evil) whose structure directly mirrors the Torah's five-stage argument. No orphaned conceptual cluster exists that would demand an additional independent package. The teaching's architecture is: יראה (Package 1) → raised by משפט (Package 3) to דעת (Package 2) → yields תורה שבנגלה (Package 4) → yields תפלה (Package 5) → yields סתרי אוריתא / בית המקדש (Package 6), with תנינא/נחש (Package 7) as the evil counterforce corrupting prayer by redirecting it to self-interest. The five divine acquisitions from Avot 6 (Torah, Heaven & Earth, Abraham, Israel, Temple) map precisely onto Packages 4, 1+2, 5, 3, and 6 respectively — confirming that the 7-package structure is the correct structural skeleton of this Torah. The 8 missing bechina edges identified in the additions file would, if added, slot into existing packages (Packages 1, 4, 5, and 6) rather than creating any new conceptual cluster. The only potentially distinct concept not captured — the Primordial Light (אור הגנוז) from the opening verse — is defined in the text itself as being equivalent to תורה שבנסתר (Package 6), confirming that it belongs there rather than forming a new package.
